properties.developer: Constellation Group, The Boschetti Group and Vietmar
properties.description: This rental-friendly condo topped off in March. It has 103 residences starting $550,000, according to one of the developers. Completion is slated for 2027.
Palma Miami Beach Residences is a 14-story, 121-residence condo tower. It has been 75 percent sold, and completion is slated for late next year, according to the developer.

72 Carlyle is a 20-story residential tower overlooking Miami Beach. It offers one, two and three-bedroom residences, as well as penthouses. Prices start at $1.1 million, according to a price list from Miami Condo Investments.

properties.developer: Witkoff Group in partnership with Ocean Terrace Holdings
properties.description: Ocean Terrace Residences comprises two towers with 350 feet of ocean frontage. Sales launched last year, and the development is expected to be completed in 2029.

properties.developer: Terra in collaboration with the Meruelo family
properties.description: Terra, in collaboration with the Meruelo family, is redeveloping the Deauville Hotel site with a reinterpreted hotel tower and modern residences, Terra said. The property is expected to generate $16 million annually for the North Beach Community Redevelopment Agency, according to the developer.
NoBe Parc Miami Beach is a 14-story, 232-unit development with residences ranging from studios to two-bedroom units. The short-term-rental-friendly project launched sales in May.

Northlink Capital is developing 7200 Collins, a 222-unit, Revuelta-designed residential tower across the street from the ocean. Sales launched last year and completion is expected next year, according to Miami Condo Investments.
